info.name: Ecommerce Store MS - Mobile API
info.description: Mobile API endpoints (/api/v1/mobile) verified against config/routes.rb and controllers in app/controllers/api/v1/mobile. Also includes the Admin App API (/api/v1/admin, folder 8) for admin@maralisanthe.com — dashboard/pricing, full bookings lifecycle (create/status transitions/cancel/deliver/invoice), full product CRUD, orders, customers, banners, and view-only pending amounts and stock.

request.description: Login using email/mobile + password. Accepts email, mobile, or username identifier. Customer logins also return customer_wallet_enabled and is_pre_booking_enabled (whether the pre-booking feature is currently turned on) in the response data.
Create a new account. user_type/role determines whether register_customer or register_agent flow runs.
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given mobile number. Only works when OTP Login is enabled in Admin > Settings > System. 60s resend cooldown, max 5 requests/hour per mobile.

Verifies the OTP and logs the user in, returning a bearer token. Auto-creates a minimal Customer/User account on first-time mobile numbers (is_new_user: true in the response) — prompt for profile completion via Settings > Update Profile afterward. Max 5 incorrect attempts before the OTP is invalidated. Also returns customer_wallet_enabled and is_pre_booking_enabled (whether the pre-booking feature is currently turned on).
Requires auth. Works for Customer/User/SubAgent.
limit default 5, capped at 10.
Requires customer auth.
Requires customer auth. Params can also be nested under 'ecommerce' or sent flat.
Maps to ecommerce#check_delivery_by_pincode. Looks up DeliveryCharge.for_pincode.
Requires customer auth. Verifies Cashfree transaction via CashfreeService.get_order.
payment_method: 'cod' or 'cashfree'. Requires customer auth.
Note: this returns Booking records (not the separate, undocumented Order model at /ecommerce/orders).
Requires delivery person auth token.

item.name: 8. Admin App
item.description: JSON API for the admin app (/api/v1/admin). Restricted to the admin@maralisanthe.com account (User#user_type == 'admin') — login below issues the bearer token this whole folder uses via {{admin_access_token}}.

request.description: Returns a JWT in data.token — copy it into the {{admin_access_token}} collection variable. Requires a User record with user_type 'admin'.

Admin home screen. Cached 5 minutes.

data: total_revenue, today_revenue, month_revenue, today_bookings, total_bookings, pending_bookings, shipped_bookings, completed_bookings, cancelled_bookings, bookings_by_status {status: count}, unpaid_bookings_count, unpaid_bookings_amount (payment_status unpaid/partially_paid, not cancelled), pending_amount_count, pending_amount_total (Pending Amounts with status pending), total_products, active_products, low_stock_products (total stock 1-10), out_of_stock_products (total stock <= 0; variant products count their variant stock), total_customers, new_customers_this_month, recent_bookings[5] {id, booking_number, customer_name, status, payment_status, total_amount, created_at}.
Active products grouped by category with price/buying_price/stock. Cached 2 minutes.

query.description: booking number, customer name/email/phone, linked customer name/mobile, or product name (ILIKE)
created on/after; YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates are ignored
created on/before; YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates are ignored

request.description: Newest first. Each booking: id, booking_number, status, payment_status, payment_method, total_amount, customer_name, customer_phone, delivery_address, items_count, is_pre_booking, created_at. Plus pagination.

List fields plus: items[] {id, product_id, product_name, variant_id, variant_label, quantity, price, total}, subtotal, tax_amount, discount_amount, shipping_charges, coupon_code, coupon_discount_amount, wallet_amount_used, cash_received, payment_completed_at, customer_id, customer_email, store {id, name}, franchise {id, name}, delivery_person {id, name, mobile}, delivery_mode, delivered_at, courier_service, tracking_number, invoice_number, cancellation_reason, stage_history, notes. 404 if not found.
Minimal admin-side booking creation. Item price is optional — defaults to the product's selling_price if omitted. customer_id is optional; customer_name/email/phone are used as a walk-in fallback.

Moves the booking to the next status. Only transitions in Booking#next_possible_statuses are allowed: draft -> ordered_and_delivery_pending/confirmed/cancelled -> processing -> packed -> shipped -> out_for_delivery -> delivered -> returned. delivered auto-completes. tracking_number is only used for the 'shipped' transition.
Only allowed while the booking is in draft/ordered_and_delivery_pending/confirmed/processing.
Only allowed while the booking is out_for_delivery. Auto-transitions to completed.
Fails with 422 if the booking already has an invoice, or has no items.
Each product now also has total_stock (variant products = sum of variant stock, same as the web products page), stock_status, has_variants, unit_type.

List fields plus description, gallery, buying_price, gst_enabled, gst_percentage, b2b_price, and variants[] {id, label, weight, unit, buying_price, selling_price, b2b_selling_price, final_price_with_gst, available_stock, low_stock_threshold, is_default}.
product_type must be one of: Milk, Grocery, Fruit & Vegetable. unit_type: Kg, Bottle, Box, Liter, Piece, Gram, Milliliter, Dozen, Packet, Bag.
Historical booking/order/invoice references are nullified rather than deleted. Fails with 422 if a foreign key still blocks deletion.

formdata.description: true = replace main image; omit/false = append to gallery

request.description: Uploads to Cloudflare R2 (folder: products). Response includes the updated gallery.
gallery_id comes from the 'id' field of an entry in Show Product's data.gallery array (e.g. r2_main, r2_additional_0).
status must be one of Order's enum values (draft, ordered_and_delivery_pending, confirmed, processing, packed, shipped, out_for_delivery, delivered, completed, cancelled, returned).
Only allowed while the order is draft/ordered_and_delivery_pending/confirmed/processing.

Profile (id, name, first_name, last_name, email, mobile, whatsapp_number, address, status, wallet_balance, created_at) plus: bookings_count, orders_count, total_spent, bookings_total (non-cancelled), unpaid_bookings_count, unpaid_bookings_amount, pending_amount_total, pending_amounts[20] {id, amount, description, pending_date, status}, addresses[] {id, name, mobile, address_type, address, landmark, city, state, pincode, is_default}, recent_bookings[10] {id, booking_number, status, payment_status, total_amount, created_at}, wallet_history[]. Email or mobile may be null (customers can register with either).
Enables/disables the customer's account (flips status).
image is optional and uploaded to Cloudflare R2; omit it (or pass image_url/r2_image_url as text fields instead) to link an already-hosted image.

query.description: pending_date on/after; YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates are ignored
pending_date on/before; YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates are ignored

request.description: View-only; same data as web Admin > Pending Amounts. data: summary {pending_count, pending_total, resolved_count, cancelled_count} (for the current filters), pending_amounts[] {id, amount, description, pending_date, status, notes, created_at, customer {id, name, mobile, email}}, pagination. Newest pending_date first.

The entry plus customer_pending_total, other_pending_amounts[] (this customer's other pending entries), unpaid_bookings_amount and unpaid_bookings[20] {id, booking_number, status, payment_status, total_amount, created_at}. 404 if not found.

View-only. Lowest stock first. data: summary {total_products, out_of_stock, low_stock, in_stock, low_stock_limit} (ignores stock_status so the tab counts stay put), products[] {id, name, sku, category {id, name}, unit_type, status, has_variants, total_stock, stock_status, main_image_url}, pagination. total_stock matches the web products page.

query.description: how many recent stock movements, default 50, max 200

request.description: Stock row plus variants[] {id, label, available_stock, low_stock_threshold, stock_status} and movements[] {id, movement_type, quantity, stock_before, stock_after, reference_type, reference_id, reference_description, notes, created_at}, newest first. 404 if not found.
